title: Benchmarking the Reliability of Post-training Quantization: a Particular Focus on Worst-case Performance
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical reliability and performance degradation of quantized deep neural networks, particularly in worst-case scenarios and under distribution shifts. While it mentions applications in 'risk-sensitive areas' like autonomous driving and finance, this is within the context of performance requirements and does not involve an evaluation or benchmarking of ethical principles, religious beliefs, or moral considerations. The term 'reliability' refers to model performance stability, not ethical reliability.
